decisionRule: No candidate is approved without behavioral demand evidence and a paid or contract-like receipt.

ideas.object: agent trace + authoritative ERP/CRM/portal outcome + exception packet
ideas.negative: native eval platforms can absorb generic assertions
ideas.killTest: 100 real runs across 3 owners; >=3 material silent failures missed by native tracing and one paid EUR 1k+ pilot

ideas.thesis: Multi-cloud/SaaS SLA claim evidence and recovery
ideas.object: incident interval + SLA version + logs + deadline + support case + posted credit
ideas.negative: future-service credits may be immaterial and availability truth is difficult
ideas.killTest: retrospective audit at 5 cloud-heavy firms; >EUR 10k eligible unclaimed credits and 2 contingency pilots

ideas.thesis: B2B agentic catalog entitlement regression gate
ideas.object: customer-specific price/eligibility versus agent-visible offer across identities and channels
ideas.negative: commerce/PIM incumbents own the data and can ship the tests
ideas.killTest: 10 merchants, 3 AI channels; material exposure/orderability mismatch in >=20% and 3 paid design partners

ideas.object: product version + vulnerability + disclosure clock + ENISA payload + receipt
ideas.negative: official tooling or existing vulnerability platforms may absorb rehearsal
ideas.killTest: 5 manufacturers run a tabletop; detect 2 novel blocking defects and obtain 2 paid pilots before 2026-09-11

ideas.object: SKU packaging BOM + supplier evidence + market/version + release decision
ideas.negative: SAP and PLM suites may absorb the gate
ideas.killTest: 20 live SKU releases at 3 firms; find 3 material discrepancies missed by current workflow and secure 2 paid pilots

ideas.object: QMS/ERP master + XML/M2M submission + rejection + published record
ideas.negative: official interfaces and regulatory software vendors can absorb it
ideas.killTest: replay 100 real records for 3 manufacturers; identify 5 consequential mismatches and 2 paid design partners

ideas.object: workbook version + formulas/links + source snapshot + invariants + approver receipt
ideas.negative: Excel, Workiva or native versioning can add generic checks
ideas.killTest: 20 close/budget workbooks; 2 high-impact novel defects plus 3 controllers willing to pay

ideas.object: shipment + CN code + embedded emissions + certificate + registry/finance posting
ideas.negative: enterprise trade suites have strong absorption power
ideas.killTest: audit 200 imports at 3 firms; material discrepancies in >=5% and 2 paid pilots

ideas.negative: AP2 is immature and networks/PSPs own the rails
ideas.killTest: inspect 100 agent-initiated transactions with one merchant/PSP; kill if volume is insufficient or native records reconcile

ideas.negative: 2027 timing plus open-source and Catena-X absorption
ideas.killTest: obtain 3 paid design partners with live multi-party lifecycle changes before building

ideas.negative: official free conformance and Inspector tooling
ideas.killTest: prove 3 consequential multi-host defects outside official coverage and one paid release-certification pilot

ideas.negative: Entra, Google, AWS, Okta and partners already cover identity, policy, registry and revocation
Shopify automatically publishes eligible products and generates agents.md; PIM suites are moving into the same layer

ideas.thesis: Generic lab core or external-R&D operations platform
ideas.negative: iLab, PPMS, Science Exchange and Quartzy cover the workflows and own distribution/data
